title: Container Hacks and Fun Images
summary: Jessie Frazelle's DockerCon SF 2015 talk on running Docker containers for desktop applications, with fun container hacks and images. It shows how far containers can be pushed beyond servers.
why: HN points to it as an illuminating look at what containers really are and as a video companion to running desktop apps in Docker.

quote.text: If you prefer video format, Jessie also has a talk at DockerCon SF 2015
